title: env_manifest
description: Machine-readable, git-tracked fact file for a generated verification environment: env.manifest.json. It has exactly three top-level layers -- vip_config (the VIP's own already-resolved config object, dumped by a zero-time UVM callback at end_of_elaboration_phase -- more reliable than a user guide because it reflects actually-applied values), dut_facts (ports/params reverse-derived from real verible --export_json RTL parsing, plus registers from a structured RAL/IP-XACT-style source), and env_topology (component hierarchy + config_db set/get pairing captured from a real uvm_top.print_topology() + +UVM_CONFIG_DB_TRACE run). Generated only -- dv_harness/env_manifest.py is the sole writer; this file is never hand-edited. Every layer that requires a real captured artifact (a VIP config dump, a topology dump, a config_db trace log) reports status=NOT_AVAILABLE with a `reason` when that artifact does not yet exist, rather than fabricating example content -- an agent reading this file must be able to tell 'genuinely captured from a real run' apart from 'not yet captured' at a glance. Deterministic key ordering and no timestamp/nondeterministic fields are baked into the content itself, so re-running the generator against unchanged real inputs produces a byte-identical file (a real diff means a real underlying change) -- this is why the schema deliberately has no 'generated_at'-style field.

version.description: env_manifest.py's own SCHEMA_VERSION at generation time, not a build timestamp -- kept diffable.

status.description: CAPTURED: vip_instances below was parsed from a real dump file a live UVM simv actually produced. NOT_AVAILABLE: no such dump exists yet for this environment -- vip_instances is an empty array, never fabricated example content.

reason.description: Required explanation when status=NOT_AVAILABLE (e.g. 'no live simv exists yet for this environment'); null when CAPTURED.

vip_instances.description: One entry per VIP config object the dump's end_of_elaboration_phase callback registered. Empty when status=NOT_AVAILABLE.

instance_path.description: Full hierarchical path of the VIP config object, exactly as get_full_name() reported it at dump time.

vip_type.description: The VIP config class's own get_type_name().

config_fields.description: Field name -> stringified resolved value, exactly as the VIP's own config object reported them (never re-derived from documentation).

reason.description: Required explanation when status=NOT_AVAILABLE (e.g. no rtl_files supplied); null when PARSED.

files.description: One entry per RTL source file, sorted by file_path for a stable diff. Each entry is verible_parser.to_dict()'s own real, unmodified shape.

status.description: LOADED: blocks below was read from a real register-map JSON file conforming to register_map.schema.json (dv_harness/schemas/register_map.schema.json is the input contract -- a RAL/IP-XACT export, never hand-invented content). NOT_AVAILABLE: no register-map input was supplied for this environment.

blocks.description: Passthrough of the register-map input's own `blocks` array, unmodified. Empty when status=NOT_AVAILABLE. See register_map.schema.json for the item shape -- deliberately not re-declared here so the two schemas cannot drift apart silently.

status.description: CAPTURED: components below was parsed from a real hierarchy dump a live UVM run's end_of_elaboration_phase actually produced (walking uvm_top's real children -- see templates/uvm_env_manifest/dv_env_manifest_pkg.sv). NOT_AVAILABLE: no such dump exists yet.

is_active.description: get_is_active() for a uvm_agent-derived component; NOT_APPLICABLE for a component with no active/passive concept -- an agent asking whether a component is active or passive reads this field instead of guessing from the component's name.

status.description: CAPTURED: entries below was extracted from a real sim log produced by a run with +UVM_CONFIG_DB_TRACE set. NOT_AVAILABLE: no such log was supplied.

parse_confidence.description: Honesty flag on how entries[].message was extracted: the outer UVM_INFO report envelope (file/line/time/reporter/id) is a stable, well-documented format and is fully parsed; the message BODY's own internal field/value sub-format is NOT further decomposed (never verified against a live UVM run in this repo) and is kept as opaque raw text in entries[].message rather than guessed apart into structured sub-fields. Null when status=NOT_AVAILABLE.

kind.description: From the report's own [CFGDB/SET] / [CFGDB/GET] message id.

message.description: Raw, unparsed message body -- see parse_confidence above.

kind.description: What real artifact this layer was read from, e.g. vip_config_dump_json, register_map_json, topology_dump_json, sim_log_uvm_config_db_trace.

path.description: Path to the real source artifact this layer was extracted from, relative to the environment root; null when status=NOT_AVAILABLE (nothing was read).
